messages.subject: Cygnet House, 8 Tabard Street SE1 - contract package
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

We act for Marchwood Property Group on its acquisition of the freehold of Cygnet House. Please send the draft contract, official copies of title TGL445218, the eight leases, the two rent deposit deeds, the certified tenancy schedule and replies to CPSE.1 (v3.8) and CPSE.4 when ready. We're instructed to work to exchange by 19 September.

Kind regards
James

James Osei
Senior Associate — Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
DDI +44 (0)20 7946 0531

messages.subject: RE: Cygnet House, 8 Tabard Street SE1 - contract package
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Contract package issued via our data room this afternoon - draft contract on the SCPC (Third Edition), official copies dated 28 August, the leases and both rent deposit deeds. Replies to CPSE will follow early next week. Our client has opted to tax and the sale is to proceed as a TOGC.

We'd be grateful if your client could confirm it will opt to tax in good time.

Regards
Alistair Whitlock
Pemberton Rowe LLP
